title: Friends on the Road
summary: Road and river folk think well enough of the player that the Kingsroad gets friendlier.

hooks.situation: Carters and boatmen trade news at every stop, and lately the news about {player} has been good.

options.label: Offer them a seat on the next wagon east

effects.text: Offer {player} a seat on the next wagon heading their way, and the cheap price for friends.

options.label: Tell them which stretches to avoid this week

effects.text: Tell {player} which stretches of the Kingsroad to avoid this week, and who is watching the crossings.

options.label: Ask them for news in return; that's how the road works

effects.text: Ask {player} for their news from the valley in trade for yours. That's how the road works.

options.label: Say nothing; wave as they pass
